requirement: Every application feature has a user story and expected behavior
acceptance_finding: 243 registry rows and activity files exist, but this independent audit found prior PASS values that were not target-runtime verified.

requirement: Test every story, document errors, fix logic/UX, then retest
source_chain_evidence: full swift test on Linux fails at SwiftUI import; activity index marks live WebKit as PARTIAL
acceptance_finding: The required complete post-fix cycle is not demonstrated in the available environment.

requirement: Normal free-provider text send returns a real non-empty answer
acceptance_finding: A direct route exists, but no target runtime response was verified and the user reports the route still fails.

requirement: Obsolete Mimo Auto is removed from the default user-facing path and renamed MiCoder Auto Free
acceptance_finding: Current source uses MiCoder Auto Free, but historical Mimo files/references remain and target UI was not rebuilt here.

requirement: Anonymous OpenCode free models such as Big Pickle work without an API key
acceptance_finding: The dedicated anonymous client and allow-list exist; live endpoint/catalog/send success is unverified.

requirement: Rate-limit/five-failure failover switches model and shows a prominent red alert
acceptance_finding: Failover and banner wiring exist, but notification semantic type is warning, not error, and no macOS visual/runtime proof exists.

requirement: Catalog is compact, complete, refreshable, lockable, and exposes model status/parameters
acceptance_finding: State methods exist, but the requested complete UX chain and live catalog result are not independently verified.

requirement: Provider-local edit/delete/refresh/login controls are discoverable and persistent
acceptance_finding: Controls are present in source, but actual macOS hit targets and persistence were not manually executed.

requirement: Sidebar resize keeps all actions reachable and moves secondary actions into a menu
acceptance_finding: ViewThatFits and bounded width exist; no target macOS resize interaction was executed.

requirement: Only one unified header remains when no project is selected
source_chain_evidence: ContentView.swift:25-41; TopBarView.swift:13-112; ChatPanelCompactHeader is defined but unused
acceptance_finding: Current source has one ContentView TopBar call, but live empty-project rendering was not checked.

requirement: Built-in DOM detection and free-AI detection are separate explicit modes
acceptance_finding: Two buttons/methods exist, but AI output is not validated through the strict model parser and the real browser interaction is unverified.

requirement: Text reaches the selected provider through hidden WKWebView and a real response is rendered
acceptance_finding: The orchestration path exists, but no macOS/WebKit send was verified and the user reports no provider works.

requirement: Exact selected model/effort are injected; failures are visible and never silently substitute
acceptance_finding: Injection is best-effort and explicitly continues with the page model after failure; screenshot reports effort not detected.

requirement: System prompt is editable, persisted, and used in web-agent first-turn behavior
acceptance_finding: Storage and preamble code exist, but the actual web prompt delivery was not observed.

requirement: Every live model including nested Expand more models entries such as Qwen Coder is discovered
acceptance_finding: Current user screenshot shows 16 header results but only 3 catalog models; current recursive fake covers one simple branch only.

requirement: Effort is discovered immediately for every model and hidden for unsupported models
source_chain_evidence: WebProvidersSection.swift:125-128,745-770; screenshot provider cards show Effort: not detected
acceptance_finding: Login persistence starts model-only refresh; profile loop exists but live effort discovery is not working.

requirement: UI labels such as Model and Model Comparison are rejected as non-models
acceptance_finding: The parser accepts any short token with letters, and current tests explicitly accept Быстрый as a Kimi model; reported false positives reproduce the defect.

requirement: Results are classified active/inactive/unsupported and invalid entries can be removed
acceptance_finding: No active/inactive/invalid classification exists for discovered web models; only manual custom removal is present.

requirement: Detected model list stays visible, complete, and uses a full-width accordion without an eight-row cap
acceptance_finding: Settings has an accordion, but provider detection uses count toggle and config.discoveredModels.prefix(8), so the requested list disappears/truncates.

requirement: Clicking a model row selects it; vertical menu contains no redundant Choose/Select action
acceptance_finding: Rows have no selection action and the vertical menu still contains Select/Выбрать plus Parameters.

requirement: Temperature, max tokens and top-p profile is discovered and saved per model without overwriting overrides
acceptance_finding: Struct and JS probe exist, but no live profile result, profile UI, or target send verification exists.

requirement: Injection failure refreshes live catalog before a safe retry
acceptance_finding: One-shot refresh status exists, but it is asynchronous/manual-retry preparation rather than a verified automatic retry and no macOS failure was triggered.

requirement: Change login creates independent named sessions and switches/restores cookies
acceptance_finding: Persistence/list/restore tests pass, but actual two-account WebKit switching was not run.

requirement: Project/local chat/provider browser instances never mix context
acceptance_finding: Local WKWebView pool is keyed correctly, but remote web context remains tied to current page and no remote UUID mapping exists.

requirement: Remote web chat UUID is stored and reused for each intended local project/chat
source_chain_evidence: WebChatDriver.swift:357-388 definitions only; ChatSession.swift:3-38; no remoteChatID field
acceptance_finding: The helper can extract a URL ID but has no production caller or persistence field.

requirement: New project/local chat/subagent creates or selects a new remote web chat when needed
acceptance_finding: The send path navigates/reuses the page and optionally clicks a title; it never creates a remote chat per local context.

requirement: Every send records project, local chat, remote chat, provider, model and effort
acceptance_finding: Journal records local chat/project/provider/model/effort but has no remote chat UUID.

requirement: Switching an existing chat selects the correct provider conversation before typing
acceptance_finding: Only a best-effort title text click is performed; stable remote UUID mapping and post-selection verification are absent.

requirement: All controls preserve visual style while remaining direct and understandable
acceptance_finding: Visual style is retained, but screenshots show confusing count-only detection, redundant Select, and small/non-accordion interactions.

requirement: Xcode/build-app.sh and macOS tests pass
source_chain_evidence: full Linux swift test log; build-app.sh target is macOS-only
acceptance_finding: The full package cannot compile in Linux because SwiftUI/AppKit are unavailable; no current macOS build log is available.

requirement: Canonical registry remains synchronized with verified status
acceptance_finding: Canonical files exist, but 225 PASS rows include items explicitly marked live verification pending or contradicted by screenshots.

requirement: Every requested change has a manual end-to-end checklist with implementation and task-fit quality
acceptance_finding: Previous checklists explicitly classify WebKit as PARTIAL, while cumulative report/CSV still promoted many items to PASS; independent re-audit was missing.
